description: Minimal capability set, scoped to this app's own webview. The renderer gets no filesystem, shell, or network access; every privileged action goes through an explicit command. Scoped by `webviews` rather than `windows` on purpose: Tauri grants a window-scoped capability to every webview in that window, which would hand IPC to a page the Browser app loaded from the internet. `core:window:allow-destroy` is the one addition to the defaults, and it exists for exactly one thing: the editor holds unsaved work, so closing is intercepted and the person is asked. Answering 'quit anyway' has to actually quit, and `close` cannot do it — `close` raises the same close request the guard is letting through, so the window would ask again for ever. It ends this app's own window and nothing else.
